content: I hadn’t tried the new Reeder until this week and it’s pretty cool. I think because I consider myself a power user of RSS, the newer apps like Reeder, Tapestry and Surf are just not as appealing to me as they might be to someone who is just getting into RSS. I have a workflow that works for me and if it aint' broke… But when I installed and started playing with Reeder, I kinda liked it. I get it.
